summary: This clinical trial studies a natural compound called jubanine to see if it helps with weight loss and reduces hunger in adults who are overweight or have obesity. Researchers plan to include 100 participants who will take either jubanine or a control supplement for three months. The study is sponsored by Universidad Católica San Antonio de Murcia. During the study, participants visit the clinic weekly for checkups and keep a diary of their symptoms.
